bearingSource: OSM way 358120845 long axis 87.8°; +X points east to the altar apse, the portal front with the two towers faces west (photos 01-02).
approximations: The OSM outline is a plain 27.8 × 11.6 m rectangle; the side apses are added beyond it from photo 03 and the parish description (≈ 16 m across the strane). West front scaled from photo 01; the east end and the south side are not photographed (mirrored/inferred); naos and chancel lengths, roof pitches and the naos drum height are estimated.

note.ro: Machetă interpretată după fotografii publice de referință. Acoperișurile, semicalotele absidelor și bulbii turlelor sunt redate în tablă de aluminiu naturală, așa cum apar în fotografii — material livrat de COLOR METAL conform evidențelor sale. Latura de sud, absida altarului și înălțimile sunt estimate.
note.hu: Nyilvános referenciafotók alapján értelmezett makett. A tetők, az apszisok félkupolái és a tornyok hagymasisakjai natúr alumíniumlemezként jelennek meg, ahogy a fotókon — a COLOR METAL nyilvántartása szerint általa szállított anyag. A déli oldal, az oltárapszis és a magasságok becsültek.
note.en: Scale model interpreted from public reference photographs. The roofs, the apse half-domes and the onion cupolas are shown in natural aluminium sheet as photographed — the material supplied by COLOR METAL according to its records. The south side, the altar apse and the heights are estimated.
